crossRefs.note: Yahweh’s Spirit came on him, and he judged Israel; and he went out to war, and Yahweh delivered Cushan Rishathaim king…
But Yahweh’s Spirit came on Gideon, and he blew a trumpet; and Abiezer was gathered together to follow him.
Yahweh’s Spirit began to move him in Mahaneh Dan, between Zorah and Eshtaol.
Yahweh came down in the cloud, and spoke to him, and took of the Spirit that was on him, and put it on the seventy…
When they came there to the hill, behold, a band of prophets met him; and the Spirit of God came mightily on him, and…
Then Samuel took the horn of oil, and anointed him in the middle of his brothers. Then Yahweh’s Spirit came mightily on…
Then the Spirit came on Amasai, who was chief of the thirty, and he said, “We are yours, David, and on your side, you…
Then the children of Ammon were gathered together and encamped in Gilead. The children of Israel assembled themselves…

people.name: Ammon
people.line: An ancient nation and its capital city, enemies of Israel.

people.name: Gilead
people.line: Mountainous region east of Jordan; tribal territory and personal name.

people.name: Jephthah
people.line: A judge of Israel, known for his tragic vow.

people.name: Manasseh
people.line: Firstborn son of Joseph, blessed by Jacob.

people.name: Ramoth
people.line: City of refuge east of the Jordan

translations.web: Then Yahweh’s Spirit came on Jephthah, and he passed over Gilead and Manasseh, and passed over Mizpah of Gilead, and from Mizpah of Gilead he passed over to the children of Ammon.
translations.bsb: Then the Spirit of the LORD came upon Jephthah, and he passed through Gilead and Manasseh, then through Mizpah of Gilead. And from there he advanced against the Ammonites.
translations.kjv: Then the Spirit of the LORD came upon Jephthah, and he passed over Gilead, and Manasseh, and passed over Mizpeh of Gilead, and from Mizpeh of Gilead he passed over unto the children of Ammon.
translations.asv: Then the Spirit of Jehovah came upon Jephthah, and he passed over Gilead and Manasseh, and passed over Mizpeh of Gilead, and from Mizpeh of Gilead he passed over unto the children of Ammon.
